description: Use-case shortlists for Theme Discovery step 1. Each entry is a ready 3-theme set — preview all three with preview_themes, then lock meta.theme.

shortlists.label: Core defaults (bundled)
shortlists.why: Bundled neon startup default, warm Claude craft paper, and IDE-dark forge — no extra theme package required.

shortlists.label: Series A / investor pitch
shortlists.why: Glass craft for AI infra, orange signal for high-impact ask, clean fintech for numbers-heavy decks.

shortlists.label: Developer product demo
shortlists.why: Phosphor terminal (Terminal Green alias), IDE-dark forge, neon startup default.

shortlists.label: Neon / cyber / nightlife launch
shortlists.why: Neon Cyber (neon-noir), mallsoft vaporwave, full-bleed wrapped energy.

shortlists.label: Design agency / brand system
shortlists.why: Swiss Modern grid, Bauhaus primaries, Electric Studio split panels.

shortlists.label: Editorial / research / annual report
shortlists.why: Warm magazine paper, FT blue rules, newsprint masthead.

shortlists.label: Consumer app / playful launch
shortlists.why: Candy blobs, hard bento cards, daisy pastel poster energy.

shortlists.label: Enterprise / boardroom
shortlists.why: Restrained boardroom, clean blue professional, signal briefing.

shortlists.label: Luxury / heritage brand
shortlists.why: Quiet luxe, heritage wash, deco gold.

shortlists.label: Bold poster / zine energy
shortlists.why: Brutal frames, sakura chroma cassette, riso zine.

shortlists.label: Climate / nature / impact
